inventory.archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
inventory.archive.consequence: It leaves ingredient pickers, stock counts and reorder suggestions. Its history stays, and you can unarchive it any time.
inventory.archive.keepsDeducting: These keep deducting and costing it after you archive it. Remove it from them if they should stop.
inventory.archive.stockStays: Archiving doesn't change stock. Those branches still see it in counts until it is counted or wasted down to zero.
inventory.archive.unused: Nothing uses it and no branch holds any.
errors.codes.INGREDIENT_NAME_ARCHIVED: An archived ingredient already has this name. Unarchive it instead of creating a new one.
errors.codes.ARCHIVE_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: This ingredient is still used or holds stock. Review where it is used, then confirm the archive.
